summary: Implemented Console.out in rich/console.py (placed after print, delegates to print with emoji/markup off, no_wrap on, overflow ignore, crop off, highlight default True). Added CHANGELOG entry "Added Console.out" under Unreleased/Added, a "Low level output" section in docs/source/console.rst after Logging, and tests in tests/test_console.py (test_out plus prefixed aspect tests; RenderHook import added at top). Nothing committed. Tests were not run per instructions, so they are unverified. Open risks: highlight tests only assert the presence of escape codes, and test_out_no_pretty_print assumes pretty printing would wrap a 10-item list at width 10.
